keyPoints: Bindu (point) ki na lambai na chaudai hoti hai; rekha (line) dono taraf anant lambi hoti hai.
Kiran (ray) ek taraf se shuru hoti hai, doosri taraf anant; rekha-khand (segment) dono taraf seemit.
Kon (angle): do kiranon ke beech ka jhukav — degree me naapa jaata hai.
Nyun kon 90° se chhota, samkon bilkul 90°, adhik kon 90° se bada lekin 180° se chhota, saral kon 180°.
Tribhuj ke teeno kono ka yog hamesha 180° hota hai.
Samantar (parallel) rekhaen kabhi nahi miltin; tiryak rekha kaatne par alternate kon barabar hote hain.
Chaturbhuj ke chaaro kono ka yog 360° hota hai.
subject: Maths
title: Rekhaganit ke Aadhaar
